units: <cite ref="Sukkah 51b:4">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שלא ראה בה״מ בבִנְיָנוֹ</he> whoever has not seen the Temple in its finished state, expl.

<cite ref="Sukkah 51b:4">ibid.</cite> <he>בִּנְיַן הורדוס</he> the Herodian Temple (Ms. M. … <he>ראה בנין בה״מ</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—<he>אַמַּת הב׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01989"><he>אַמָּה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 102b:7">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>דרך ב׳ בכן</he> such kind of labor belongs to builders’ work.
Ib. דמי לב׳ it looks like builders’ work; a. fr.—בִּנְיַן אב standard rule, v. אָב; v.

<cite ref="Chullin 78b">Ḥull. 78ᵇ</cite>, <cite ref="Bava Kamma 77b:13">B. Kam. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>זה בנה אב</he> this (<cite ref="Exodus 12:5">Ex. XII, 5</cite>) forms the rule, wherever <cite ref="U00293"><he>שה</he></cite> is used &c. (v. Tosaf. a. l.).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 114a:7">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>בִּנְיָנוֹ של עולם</he> the preservation of the (mental and moral) world.

senses.gloss: human frame, skeleton. Ohol. II, 1 רוב בניינו the greater portion of a corpse as to size of limbs, contrad. to רוב מניינו the larger as to the number of joints and limbs.
